title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MUTEZIMANA
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MUTEZIMANA
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA00641/2025/CA (Kaliwabo, J. P.) 06 Gashyantare
2026]
Amategeko agenga imanza nshinjabyaha – Igabanyagihano – Icyaha gihanishwa igihano cy’igifungo
cya burundu n’ihazabu, icyo gihano gishobora kugabanywa iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha
zemejwe n’umucamanza, ariko ntikijye munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15) n’ihazabu ikaba
yagabanywa, ariko ntijye munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto iteganyirijwe icyaha cyakozwe.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Ubushinjacyaha bwareze Mutezimana mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Rubavu,
bumukurikiranyeho icyaha cyo gutunda ibiyobyabwenge bihambaye byo mu bwoko bw’urumogi, mu
guca urubanza Urukiko rumuhamya icyo cyaha, rumuhanisha igifungo cy’imyaka 25 n’ihazabu ya
20.000.000Frw.
Uregwa yajuririye bwa mbere mu Rukiko Rukuru, urugereko rwa Musanze, narwo rumuhamya icyo
cyaha ariko rumugabanyiriza ibihano, rumuhanisha gufungwa imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw.
Urwo rubanza Uregwa nirwo yajuririye bwa kabiri muri uru Rukiko rw’Ubujurire asaba kongera
kugabanyirizwa ibihano yahanishijwe.
Muri uru rubanza, Uregwa asobanura ko guhera mu nzego z’iperereza yemeye icyaha akagisabira
imbabazi, ndetse ko aribwo bwa mbere yari akoze icyaha, bityo akaba asaba kongera kugabanyirizwa.
Avuga kandi ko nawe asanga yarahawe ibihano bito biteganywa n’Itegeko, ariko ko akomeza
gutakambira Urukiko kugira ngo rumugabanyirize ibihano.
Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije ubujurire bw’Uregwa buvuga ko igihano yahawe aricyo gito gishoboka ku
cyaha aregwa, akaba adashobora kongera kugabanyirizwa.
Incamake y’icyemezo: Icyaha gihanishwa igihano cy’igifungo cya burundu n’ihazabu, icyo gihano
gishobora kugabanywa iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha zemejwe n’umucamanza, ariko ntikijye
munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15) n’ihazabu ikaba yagabanywa ariko ntijye munsi ya
kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto iteganyirijwe icyaha cyakozwe.
Ubujurire nta shingiro bufite.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 4/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/8/2018 riteganya
ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 2.
Itegeko No 69/2019 ryo kuwa 08/11/2019 rihindura ingingo ya 263 y’Itegeko No 68/2018 ryo kuwa
30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 11.
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RPAA00006/2025/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Nzabonimpa Vincent, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire
ku wa 30/1/2026.
RPAA00538/2024, Ubushinjacyaha na Cyuzuzo Jean Claude rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku
wa 21/01/2025.

Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Mutezimana Josiane yakurikiranweho kuba ku wa 26/11/2021 yarakoze icyaha cyo gutunda
ibiyobyabwenge bihambaye byo mu bwoko bw’urumogi aregerwa Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Rubavu
mu rubanza RP00811/2021/TGI/RBV rwaciwe ku wa 30/12/2021.
[2] Muri urwo rubanza, Mutezimana Josiane yahamijwe icyaha cyo gutunda ibiyobyabwenge
bihambaye byo mu bwoko bw’urumogi ahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 25 n’ihazabu ya
20.000.000Frw, ajurira mu Rukiko Rukuru,Urugereko rwa Musanze narwo rumuhamya icyaha,
rumuhanisha gufungwa imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw.
[3] Mutezimana Josiane yajuririye Urukiko rw’Ubujurire, ubujurire bwe bwandikwa kuri
RPAA00641/2025/CA, iburanishwa rishyirwa ku wa 4/2/2026, uregwa yitaba yunganiwe na Me
Munyansanga Amina Giselle naho Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Rudatinya N. Gaspard.
[4] Mu mwanzuro we w’ubujurire Mutezimana nta kindi yasabye uretse kongera kugabanyirizwa
igihano, agahabwa igifungo cy’imyaka 5 kuko guhera mu nzego z’iperereza yemeye icyaha
akanagisabira imbabazi ndetse aribwo bwa mbere yari akoze icyaha. Mu iburanisha ryo ku wa
04/02/2026 Mutezimana avuga ko nawe asanga ibihano yahawe aribyo bito ntarengwa biteganywa
n’Itegeko ariko ko akomeza gutakambira Urukiko kugira ngo rumugabanyirize ibihano.
[5] Ubushinjacyaha busubiza ko igihano yahawe aricyo gito gishoboka hakurijwe ingingo ya 2 (a)
y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 4/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/8/2018
riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, akaba adashobora kongera kugabanyirizwa.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[6] Ikibazo cyo kugabanya igihano kubera impamvu nyoroshyacyaha mu gihe igihano cyatanzwe
aricyo gito gishoboka, cyatanzweho umurongo mu rubanza RPAA00538/2024 rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 21/01/2025 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Cyuzuzo Jean Claude, aho rwemeje ko,
iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha zemejwe n’umucamanza icyaha gihanishwa igihano cy’igifungo
cya burundu n’ihazabu, icyo gihano gishobora kugabanywa ariko ntikijye munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka
cumi n’itanu (15) n’ihazabu ikaba yagabanywa ariko ntijye munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto
iteganyirijwe icyaha cyakozwe; uyu murongo ukaba ushingiye ku ngingo ya 2 y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023
ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano
muri rusange. Uyu murongo niwo wakomeje gukurikizwa mu manza zaciwe n’uru Rukiko, rumwe mu
ziheruka akaba ari urubanza RPAA00006/2025/CA1.
[7] Kubera izo mpamvu, uru Rukiko rurasanga ubujurire bwa Mutezimana Josiane nta shingiro
bufite kuko igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw yahawe n’Urukiko Rukuru
aricyo gito gishoboka ku cyaha yahamijwe, bityo kikaba kidashobora kongera kugabanywa.
1 Reba Urubanza RPAA00006/2025/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire kuwa 30/1/2026 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na
Nzabonimpa Vincent.

II. ICYEMEZO CY’URUKIKO
[8] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwa Mutezimana Josiane nta shingiro bufite.
[9] Rwemeje ko imikirize y’urubanza RPA00009/2023/HC/MUS rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru,
Urugereko rwa Musanze kuwa 3/04/2025, idahindutse mu ngingo zarwo zose.
[10] Rwemeje ko igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu n’ihazabu y’amafaranga 5.000.000
Mutezimana Josiane yahanishijwe kigumyeho.
